title: GIANT Credible Sets to Cell Type (CS2CT) tool
bodyHtml:
page-description

The CS2CT tool allows you to explore whether credible set (CS) variants for a phenotype of interest are located within tissue-specific epigenomic annotations. This can provide clues about which genes are impacted by genetic variation, and in which tissues this occurs. Click the Research Method tab below for a video walkthrough of the tool.

The results on this page are derived from single-ancestry GWAS. Please visit the Trans-ancestry CS2CT tool to access Trans-ancestry results.

Getting started

  • Set a phenotype, ancestry, sex, and tissue (note that data may not be available for some phenotype/ancestry combinations), and click Search.
  • Choose a CS of interest in the CS2CT by tissue table and click Load variants. Now all sections display data for the coordinates of the CS ± 200 kb.
  • Visit each section to see descriptions of their content and how to navigate them.
  • You can mark specific variants to follow them across the visualizations. See the Research Method tab below for details.
  • You can create a downloadable table summarizing your findings using the Data Summary Section at the bottom of the page. See the Research Method tab below for details.

c2ct_tissue-description

Use this section to browse, sort, and filter CS for the selected phenotype across the genome that overlap with epigenomic annotations in the selected tissue. Mouse over the plot to view credible sets with their PPO (probability that the causal SNP overlaps the annotation) and entropy (a measure of the degree to which the causal SNP overlaps only this annotation). In the table, click the View button to see more information. Choose a CS of interest and click the Load variants button to populate the sections below with data for the region of that CS ± 200 kb. Note: if you load variants for a CS and then want to explore a different CS, please click the Reset button and start a new search.

 

credible_variants-description

The Variants in credible set tab lists the variants in the CS you have selected. 

credible_sets-description

The Other credible sets in region tab lists all CS that overlap with the selected region. Click on the CS ID of one or more sets to add their variants to the Variants in credible set tab.

associations-description

This section displays genetic associations for the selected phenotype across the region of the CS ± 200 kb. To view associations in a different region, enter chromosomal coordinates or a gene name in the Region box. Entering a gene name returns the coding sequence ± 50 kb. Note that searching a new region here does not change the data loaded in other sections of the page.

enriched_regions-description

This section displays tissue-specific epigenomic annotations in the selected tissue. Mouse over the graphic for more information about each region. Dataset accession numbers are from the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.

This section allows you to generate a downloadable table summarizing the results from your search.

  • Checking only Credible Variants in Region displays the variants that are present in both the the Variants in credible set section and the Variants in CS region ± 200 k section.
  • Checking only Annotations in Region displays all of the variants from the Variants in CS region ± 200 k section that are present in annotated regions in the selected tissue, as displayed in the Annotated regions section.
  • Checking both Credible Variants in Region and Annotations in Region displays the variants shared between these two summaries.
  • After changing your selections, click the Update summary button.
  • Click Save data/set table in the upper right to format and download the results.
